verdict.rationale: Apify documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents and LLMs discover and run Actors (apify-docs-10, apify-probe-3), and it publishes llms.txt and an OpenAPI spec (apify-probe-1, apify-probe-2). This makes natural-language operation possible, but only through a third-party agent or LLM client, not a first-party natural-language interface. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which platform operations can be driven via natural language, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
